slides.texte_overlay:
hidden signs your mind is
sharper than most

you question your own answers

you check your first thought before trusting it. people who know a lot are usually aware of how much they still don't know, so a little doubt is a good sign.

repetition bores you

small talk and routine drain you quickly because your mind wants fresh ideas. a brain that gets bored easily is usually one that is always hungry to learn something.

you think out loud

you talk yourself through problems, quietly or out loud. putting thoughts into words slows them down and organises them, which helps you find better answers faster.

you chase odd questions

you wonder why cats purr or how old the moon is, and you love finding out the answers. that constant wondering is the habit behind almost every brilliant mind.
slides.texte_sophia:
you chase odd questions

you chase odd questions, like why cats purr. the Sophia app turns them into one short lesson a day, and 5 minutes of curiosity keeps a sharp mind happy and growing.

slides.texte_overlay:
you catch tiny details

you spot what others miss: a shift in tone, a crooked frame, a pattern in numbers. paying close attention to small things is one of the quietest signs of intelligence.
